_comment: Word lists from '80% of Qur'anic Words' (Dr Abdulazeez Abdulraheem, Islamic Book Trust). Nouns keep the book's topic heading as their category; verbs keep their baab (verb pattern). 'count' is the book's Qur'an occurrence figure. 'sense' is shared by true synonyms so the quiz never offers two correct answers.

source.title: 80% of Qur'anic Words
source.author: Dr Abdulazeez Abdulraheem
source.note: Function words (book pages 1-6) are left out: 'not', 'this', 'except' and the like do not make a fair four-option meaning question.

words.en: one who takes care of a thing for another
to be true, to say the truth
to bear witness, to be present
to become nigh, to be close to
to be satisfied, to be content
to adorn, to make seem fair
to pronounce someone to be true
to call out, to cry unto
to do good, to do excellently
to send back, to take back
to become good, to make good
to leave in error, to send astray
to wait and watch for opportunity
to turn away, to take for friend
to make someone die, to receive in full
to be on guard, to protect oneself
to find or follow the right path
to be straight, to act straight
